findings.issue: Non-ok responses throw `ReferenceError` on undefined `res` (parameter is `response`); intended error message and ApiError are never produced
findings.suggestion: Fix to `response.status/statusText` and add a unit test driving a non-ok response through `api()`/`tryApi()`

findings.issue: Promise cached before settling, so one transient API failure permanently poisons that URL until restart
findings.suggestion: Evict from the cache on rejection (e.g. `request.catch(() => cache.delete(url))`) and test the retry-after-failure behaviour

findings.issue: Zero tests and no test infrastructure despite ~500 LOC of pure, easily testable logic (format.ts, buildMoveTables, evolutionTree, pagination math)
findings.suggestion: Add `node:test` (bundled with Node 24) unit tests for the lib/ pure functions; no new dependency needed

findings.issue: Pagination clamping (page=0, NaN, beyond-total) and filter-param preservation in pageUrl are untested
findings.suggestion: Extract page-clamp/pageUrl into lib and unit-test edge cases: out-of-range pages, empty filters, page param dropped

findings.issue: buildMoveTables fixed method order (level-up/machine/egg/tutor) and level-up tie-break rely on array order with no test
findings.suggestion: Table-driven test over a small fixture asserting method order, level sort, and tie-break by move label

findings.issue: Default game = highest-order version group via at(-1) after sort; a sort-key change silently alters every Pokémon page's default table
findings.suggestion: Unit test getMoveSectionData ordering/default with a two-group fixture

findings.issue: Click-sort behaviour (missing-values-last in both directions, numeric vs text, aria-sort reset) has no fast guard
findings.suggestion: Test cellValue/sort comparator against row fixtures with empty data-sort-value cells

findings.issue: Species list dedup, <10000 boundary filter and id sort are only covered end-to-end by the acceptance overlay
findings.suggestion: Unit test getSpeciesList with mocked api responses including a >10000 id and a duplicate

findings.issue: Exported ApiError class is dead code, never thrown
findings.suggestion: Throw ApiError in the non-ok branch (after fixing `res`) and assert on its status in tests

findings.issue: Inline re-implementation of idFromUrl/isSpeciesId for the type filter; drift between the two copies is unguarded
findings.suggestion: Reuse idFromUrl/isSpeciesId from api.ts and unit-test the shared filter helper

summary: The app ships no tests of any kind — no runner, no script, no assertions — while its riskiest layers (API caching/error handling, filtering, pagination, sort ordering) go completely unguarded. Two latent bugs in exactly that untested layer (an undefined-variable ReferenceError in the error path and permanently-cached rejected promises) show the cost of the gap concretely. The saving grace is that the risky logic is mostly pure functions in lib/ that could be covered with Node's built-in test runner in an afternoon.
